text:
**A.** Bill signed and delivered the deed, so the condominium passed as a valid lifetime gift to him and Kathy as tenants by the entirety. Kathy took it by survivorship at his death, outside the will. Her prenuptial waiver bars only her claims against the estate, such as pretermitted-spouse and elective-share rights, and doesn't bar a lifetime gift. So Tommy takes the pasture land, and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 85
